reviews.comment: Get ready to be called on in class, most of his examples either use the exact same #s or don't really make sense compared to what the topic is. Extremely confusing organization of lecture topics, & the exams will have work-out questions that differ from in-class examples. He will not provide exam prep besides textbook questions that don't help much

One of my favorite professors to date. He is not only funny, but extremely engaging. If you get the chance, go to his office hours; he has so many interesting things to say from his vast career. Make sure to pay attention because he does like to call on every student to get an answer, and will not let you off the hook easily if you can't respond.

Arvind is very knowledgeable about everything international finance. His credentials are beyond comprehension, he will tell you all about it. We had 3 exams total. He curved all of them. If you are looking for an easy elective, look elsewhere. You have to read the book to understand a lot of his topics as well. Goodluck!

While the course material was quite difficult, Professor Mahajan made sure each and every student understood the material and would not proceed forward if anyone was confused. His lectures were super interesting and it was evident that he deeply cared about his students!

I hated every professor I've ever taken in my time as a finance major at Texas A&M until I took Dr. Mahajan's class. He is actually so engaging and his lectures are phenomenal. If you can pay attention, he makes it interesting and very engaging to learn and absorb information. Highly recommend
